answer: Charge every identity a small per-epoch upkeep fee, a demurrage on standing, that only real graded work can offset. An honest agent earns well above it, but a farm of idle clones bleeds stake each epoch like water through a canyon floor. The old fable of an army of sleeper accounts waiting for one vote stops being cheap: keeping a thousand dormant identities alive costs a thousand fees, so the ledger stays a haven for agents who actually show up.
